profile.headline: Manufacturing Quality, Hardware Test Engineering, Software Development, Test Requirements & Specs
profile.summary:
A leader with deep technical experience in manufacturing test (H/W, S/W, & systems), supplier quality, operations, and manufacturing quality. Developing skills on OSS projects. MS EET Indiana State Univ, ASQ certified Six Sigma, Reliability Engineer

Recent:
Created open-source software projects written in Modular's Mojo, a pythonic programming language for blazing-fast CPU+GPU execution without CUDA, and MAX inference framework for AI.

Experience:
Whirlpool: Responsible for developing and deploying functional test standards across all manufacturing plants. Includes developing standards for test coverage and statistical capability, test system hardware & software platforms, enterprise reporting and scorecards around key metrics to drive improvement and capital/resource investment. Led team development of Whirlpool’s new test platform based on NI cDAQ hardware, LabVIEW, and TestStand. Created a new MS SQL server database, defined all tables, and wrote SQL stored procedures for common functions. For production test in Whirlpool plants, created a new software application using Python 3 with the front-end GUI implemented in QT6.

CNH: SQE manager for suppliers of electrical and electronic components in the NAFTA region, supporting all CNH plants and all models of CNH construction and agriculture equipment. Coordinate globally with SQE colleagues on quality standards and procedures, and to resolve supplier quality issues affecting CNH plants in other global regions.

Perform quality audits at supplier plants, apply APQP process to approve PPAP’s for new parts, review PFMEAs, control plans and work instructions, coordinate field campaigns with suppliers. Manage supplier quality metrics (e.g. ppm) and work with suppliers to address one-time quality issues, chronic issues, and field issues.

TRW: Customer quality manager for domestic and Japanese customers in manufacturing facility for automotive electronics. Work closely with TRW design team and quality counterparts in Japan to address customer quality issues, with international travel as needed. Attained Six Sigma Black Belt certification from ASQ in 2007. Awarded US Patent in 2007 for manufacturing improvement of production test equipment.

Technical manager for engineering group that developed and supported production test equipment for high-volume automotive electronics manufacturer. Includes assigning work, performance appraisals, disciplinary action & performance management.

Allied Signal Aerospace: Designed avionic test systems for hydromechanical/electronic fuel controls on military jet engines.

positions.title: Independent Software Developer
positions.description:
Experienced with Modular's ecosystem consisting of Mojo, a pythonic programming language for blazing-fast CPU+GPU execution without CUDA, and MAX, a high-performance inference framework for AI which provides powerful libraries and tools to develop, optimize and deploy AI on GPUs fast. Experienced with Augment Code, an AI agentic coding platform backed by Anthropic's Claude Code Sonnet context engine.

A seasoned leader with deep technical experience in manufacturing test (H/W, S/W, & systems), supplier quality, operations, and manufacturing quality. Developing skills on OSS projects. MS EET Indiana State University, ASQ certified Six Sigma and Reliability Engineer.

Recent:
- Asana Daily Log: An OSS project written in Mojo with interoperability to Python for functions and libraries currently absent from Mojo's ecosystem. This application interacts with the online web service Asana to implement a personal Daily Log system organized around a dedicated Asana project for each year.

- Inverted Pendulum: An OSS project written in Mojo and MAX GPU framework. This AI project developed a digital twin and control system for an inverted pendulum based on sample data obtained from the physical apparatus. The sample data of the pendulum system is from the final project for my MS degree from Indiana State University.

- Augment Code: Applying this agentic AI software development platform as an extension within VS Code to add features to an existing project (Asana Daily Log) and to develop a completely new application (Inverted Pendulum).

positions.title: Director of Quality and Operations
positions.description:
I led the company to achieve ISO/TS 16949 certification, and directed operations to achieve efficiency and quality targets. This includes making plant changes needed for new manufacturing projects, proposing and implementing capital equipment projects. I also performed analysis for capacity planning, cost reduction and/or methods for process control. Participate and lead on new product launch APQP (PFMEA, DFMEA, PPAP, etc). Helped define engineering guidelines. Directed supplier quality as well as the internal quality, including audits. Led the continuous improvement of product, manufacturing process, and quality.

Inverom is a unique, vertically integrated partner for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) looking to deliver a game-changing user experience in their products.

With specialized expertise in user interface, battery management and other electronic and electrical subsystems, we deliver state-of-the-art platforms and solutions that span the entire value chain, from design and engineering to development, manufacturing, assembly, test and distribution for automotive and off-road vehicle applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Multitasking · Quality Assurance · Business Understanding · Critical Thinking · Functional Specifications · Functional Requirements

positions.title: Manager, Supplier Quality Engineering - Electrical/Electronics
positions.description:
I managed the electrical SQE team from the CNH headquarters in Burr Ridge, IL (i.e. Chicago). My team was responsible for all types of electrical components – wire harnesses, sensors (e.g. pressure, fuel level, temperature), radios, electric pumps, lighting, instrument clusters, batteries, alternators, starters, etc. 
We audited new suppliers to determine their suitability for new business, perform process audits on current production, and I personally performed supplier sustainability/social responsibility audits.
I also managed supplier quality metrics across all commodities (e.g. electrical, metallic, fab & weld, chemical & plastics) for the entire SQE department, and support making administrative changes outside the normal process flow within the CNH quality management system.
positions.insights: Skills: Multitasking · Quality Assurance · Supplier Quality · Critical Thinking

positions.title: Moderator
positions.description: A volunteer position. Chair of the church's executive Board which is responsible for managing the financial business, staff management, and formal policy aspects of the congregation. Also setup and managed a web-accessable file server (CentOS Linux) for the church.

positions.title: Customer Quality Manager
positions.description: Manager of team consisting of two customer quality engineers and one quality technician with the responsibility for all quality-related activities for Chrysler and Mitsubishi customers. This included new product introduction (NPI), in-process quality, and assembly plant and warranty returns for airbag electronic sensors. Worked closely with TRW counterparts in Japan office to support Mitsubishi customer. Traveled several times to Japan to meet directly with Mitsubishi Engineering and Plant Quality at multiple customer locations.

positions.title: Principal Product Engineer - Test
positions.description:
Principal / Lead Engineer, Technical Manager
Lead, quote, develop and implement projects resulting in new test systems and quality related processes. Implement spending plans for customer funded tooling and capital projects. Included annual capital planning. Create requirements documents, RFQ’s, and specifications. Interview candidates for permanent positions and special projects. Retain the services of venders and contract employees to obtain skills & expertise not available in-house.

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description: Developed avionic test systems for hydromechanical and electronic fuel control systems used for military and commercial gas turbine engines.  Responsibilities included test system conceptual design, cost estimating, project management, hardware and software definition, detailed hardware & software design, and documentation of test systems for use by Allied Signal product design engineering, within the manufacturing facility, and at customer sites.

patents.title: Quick disconnect interface for environmental testing
patents.description: An apparatus tests different products. The apparatus includes an environmental chamber for providing thermal shock to the products, a conveyor for transporting the products through the environmental chamber, a fixture movable with the products through the environmental chamber, and an interface removably mounted on the fixture. The fixture has a means for electric stimulation and monitoring of the products during transport of the products through the environmental chamber. The interface is constructed to test one of the different products. The interface provides a mechanical and electrical connection between the fixture and the product being tested. The interface is tailored for stimulating and monitoring the product being tested.
